2021 Q3.gq: For the full year 2021, we now expect revenue to increase approximately 65% over 2020, driven by growth across all businesses, up from the prior guidance of 60%.

2021 Q4.gq: First quarter 2022 revenue is expected to be approximately $5 billion, plus or minus $100 million, an increase of approximately 45% year-over-year and approximately 4% quarter-on-quarter.

2022 Q2.gq: For the third quarter of 2022, we expect revenue to be approximately $6.7 billion, plus or minus $200 million, an increase of approximately 55% year-over-year, primarily led by growth in the Data Center and Embedded segments.

2022 Q3.gq: For the fourth quarter of 2022, we expect revenue to be approximately $5.5 billion, plus or minus $300 million, an increase of approximately 14% year-over-year and flat sequentially.

2022 Q4.gq: For the first quarter of 2023, we expect revenue to be approximately $5.3 billion, plus or minus $300 million, a decrease of approximately 10% year-over-year and 5% sequentially.

2023 Q3.gq: We expect revenue to be approximately $6.1 billion, plus or minus $300 million, an increase of approximately 9% year-over-year and 5% sequentially.

2023 Q4.gq: We expect revenue to be approximately $5.4 billion plus or minus $300 million.

2024 Q2.bq: We delivered strong second quarter financial results with revenue coming in above the midpoint of guidance and profitability increasing by a double-digit percentage driven by higher than expected sales of our Instinct, Ryzen, and EPYC processors.

2024 Q3.gq: As a result, we now expect Data Center GPU revenue to exceed $5 billion in 2024, up from $4.5 billion we guided in July and our expectation of $2 billion when we started the year.

2024 Q4.gq: We expect revenue to be approximately $7.1 billion plus or minus $300 million, up 30% year-over-year, driven by strong growth in our data center and the client business.

2025 Q2.gq: For the third quarter of 2025, we expect revenue to be approximately $8.7 billion, plus or minus $300 million.
2025 Q2.bq: We delivered record revenue of $7.7 billion, exceeding the middle point of our guidance, up 32% year-over-year, reflecting strong momentum across our business.

2025 Q3.gq: For the fourth quarter of 2025, we expect revenue to be approximately $9.6 billion plus or negative $300 million.

2026 Q2.bq: In server, we delivered our fifth consecutive quarter of record server CPU revenue with cloud and enterprise sales each growing more than 70% year-over-year, exceeding the outlook we provided last quarter.

2026 Q3.gq: We expect revenue to be approximately $17 billion, plus or minus 3%.
2026 Q3.bq: We significantly exceeded our previous outlook of more than 80% growth as we gained revenue share.
